newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 3.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 3.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Thursday:
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 73.05 points or 0.95 percent to close at 7795.38 following inaction on interest rates by the U.S. Federal Reserve.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index gained 5.98 points to 1,084.88.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.5244/54 a dollar at around 0100 GMT, against its Kuala Lumpur ending on Wednesday at 2.5245/50, and near Bank Negara's intervention level on Wednesday at 2.5250.

* Market will continue to watch for Thailand news following the baht's flotation on Wednesday on possible spill-over effects, analysts said. Kuala Lumpur took the baht's float in its stride on Wednesday.
* Stock of women undergarment maker Audrey International AURY.KL lists on second board, with offer price of 2.0 ringgit.
* Timber firm Jaya Tiasa said it paid $12.1 million for a Brazilian firm which owns a sawmill, a plywood mill and several parcels of industrial land.
* Construction firm Gold Bridge Engineering & Construction said it was planning a one-for-one bonus issue, and will develop a shopping mall.
